 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 13 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Let love pour into your life, Scorpio . Let yourself rest, let yourself play,y and just be without worries for one single day. You have been contemplating your moves in a million directions for the longest time, and you may have been mentally putting your ideas to the test, carefully weighing out the pros and cons of it all. However, there is no need to jump to the ‘right’ conclusions today. The simplest way out would be to consider your thoughts and explore your interests to pick what feels best fitting for the next chapter in your life. Some ladders may feel tall and shiny but may lead nowhere, and some cups may feel small for now but may be filled with gold.
 Cosmic tip: Trust your gut unquestioningly. Give it a shot at least once; you won't regret it.
